messages:
Nadia (PM): Opening thread: proposal for a 'risk-tiered' onboarding flow. Target: codify different admission paths for low/medium/high-risk models (privacy, hallucination risk, cost delta). Want clear bench gates, pin defaults, and a customer migration SLA. Quick reactions?
Theo (Eng): Love the idea. Must include runtime fences and an immediate rollback path. Suggest hardware isolation for high-risk and enforced canary suppression rules.
Ravi (ML): Bench proposal by risk tier: low: p95<=130ms, eval F1>=0.88, cost<=1.2x; medium: p95<=140ms, eval>=0.9, cost<=1.15x, token parity<=2%; high: p95<=120ms, eval>=0.93, cost<=1.05, additional human review. High-risk also needs adversarial prompt checks. I'll own the suites.
Sasha (CS): Customers asked for pin clarity. Recommend defaults: low=30d, medium=60d, high=90d. All tenant-opt-in. For high-risk allow a "contractual pin" option (sales/legal). Need migration playbooks per tier and a Console flag that shows pin status + unpin ETA.
Ivy (Sales): We'll want a short AE blurb per tier. Sample: "High-risk pin available for 90 days; extensions require contract amendment." I'll draft these and route to legal.
Legal-bot: Please submit pin-extension templates via legal-requests. Note: any SLA changes for pins must be reviewed; do not promise custom SLAs without ticket.
Infra-bot: Created job templates: job/risk-onboard-low, job/risk-onboard-medium, job/risk-onboard-high. Regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1. Alerts include latency_p95, error_rate_spike, infra_incident. Dashboards created under /dash/risk-onboard/.
Theo (Eng): Draft runtime config sketch (simple):
```
risk_tier: high
stages:
  - smoke_days: 3
  - micro_canary_days: 7
    traffic_pct: 3
  - graded_canary_days: 14
    traffic_pct: 20
runtime_fences: [hold_flag, hardware_pin, canary_suppress_on_incident]
pin_defaults_days: 90
owners: [Nadia, Theo, Ravi, Sasha]
```
Ravi (ML): For high-risk add adversarial set (100 prompts) + 50 human spot-checks. If >5 failures, fail. Also add embedding drift and hallucination scoring.
Sasha (CS): Migration playbooks: low=automatic soft-unpin 7d ramp; medium=14d ramp + customer notice; high=30d ramp + CS-run cutover. I'll draft templates. Need Console copy and an FAQ item.
Ivy (Sales): I'll prepare AE blurb matrix and a short one-paragraph legal-friendly statement for contracts. ETA Tue.
Theo (Eng): I'll wire runtime fences and add autoscale floor for medium+high. Also ensure batch caps and kernel affinity for high-risk models. ETA Fri.
Nadia (PM): Decision rule: PM + Eng lead + ML lead + CS rep + Legal signoff for any "high" tier admission. Medium requires PM+Eng+ML+CS; low requires PM+Eng. Any single veto holds. Action items: Ravi finalize bench suites; Theo infra job configs; Sasha migration playbooks + Console copy; Ivy + Legal produce AE and contract blurb. Scheduling 30m decision sync next Wed to review bench outputs. :thumbsup:
Ivy (Sales): Noted, will push AE blurb to legal now.
Ravi (ML): Starting bench runs against baseline today; will post metrics here when done.
Theo (Eng): Adding draft job configs to infra repo and linking dashboards. Will post links when merged.
Sasha (CS): Drafting playbooks and FAQ, will share Monday.
Nadia (PM): Thanks team. If runway looks good, we roll this out as the catalog's default risk-aware admission policy next quarter.
